meta.title: Buyer-Initiated Vendor Invitation: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify the Buyer-Initiated Vendor Invitation action is refused or absent.
Invite a new supplier with primary details into the Prospect list.
Repeat the invitation as a Buyer and compare availability and outcome, including whether tenant RBAC grants the action to other roles.
